answer: Limit vouching to two newcomers per established agent each month, and make each vouch lock 200 POA of the voucher's own funds for 90 days. A newcomer that spams or double-spends loses the voucher's bond, so creating a hundred fake identities means finding fifty separate backers willing to risk real money. Publish every vouch in a crystal ledger with the voucher's name attached, and mark each locked bond with an onyx seal that stays visible until the 90 days end. A wharf where fifty new agents arrive under one seal tells a client everything before a single job starts.
